Key executive orders explicitly call for sustaining 'America's global AI dominance' and promoting 'economic competitiveness,' while safety and trustworthiness measures are framed as enablers of that leadership rather than as ends in themselves.","evidence_spans":[{"quote":"Calls for an action plan to sustain and enhance America's global AI dominance in order to promote human flourishing, economic competitiveness, and national security.","source_section":"Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence (1/23/2025)"},{"quote":"ensure that the U.S. government is at the forefront of evaluating national security risks in frontier models","source_section":"Winning the Race: America's AI Action Plan (7/23/2025)"},{"quote":"build high-security data centers for military and intelligence community usage; bolster critical infrastructure cybersecurity","source_section":"Winning the Race: America's AI Action Plan (7/23/2025)"},{"quote":"Directs NIST to create a plan for federal engagement in the development of technical standards and related tools in support of reliable, robust, and trustworthy systems that use AI technologies.","source_section":"Executive Order on Maintaining American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence (2/14/2019)"}]}
